newsitem.title: USA: Ross Stores August same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Ross Stores August same-store sales rise.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc Thursday said sales for the four week period ended August 31 rose to $130 million from $111 million a year ago. Same-store sales rose 11 percent on a day-for-day basis from the prior year.

For the seven months through August 31, sales were $907 million, an 18 percent increase above the $769 million in sales for the prior year's comparable period ended September 2. Comparable store sales for the seven months increased 11 percent on a day-for-day basis from the prior year.
